name: Standard buyer deflection set
note: The questions a security reviewer asks before they send a questionnaire. Each one answered here is one that never becomes an inbound request.

questions.text: Do you maintain a formal, approved information security program and policy?
Are formal risk assessments performed at least annually?
Do you hold a current SOC 2 Type II attestation?
Is your organization ISO/IEC 27001 certified?
Are you certified to ISO/IEC 42001 for AI management systems?
Has an independent penetration test been performed in the last 12 months?
Is customer data encrypted in transit?
Is customer data encrypted at rest, and how are keys managed?
Is multi-factor authentication enforced for workforce access to production?
How often are user access rights reviewed, and how quickly is access revoked on termination?
Within how many days of contract termination is customer data deleted?
Do you maintain a published subprocessor list?
Where is customer data hosted, and in which regions?
What personal data does the service retain, and for how long?
Do you have a documented incident response plan, and within what timeframe are customers notified of a confirmed breach?
Is the incident response plan tested at least annually?
What are your RTO and RPO for production services?
Do production code changes require peer review and automated security testing before release?
What are your remediation timelines for critical and high severity vulnerabilities?
Are audit logs centrally collected and protected from tampering?
Do employees complete security awareness training at hire and annually?
Are background checks performed for new hires where legally permitted?
Are company endpoints centrally managed with disk encryption and enforced patching?
Do you assess the security posture of critical third parties and subprocessors?
Do you use customer data to train, fine-tune or improve any model?
What data can your models access, and what are the boundaries on that access?
How is a human kept in the loop over AI-generated output?
How does the system resist prompt injection?
What agent permissions and MCP exposure does the system have?
How is data leakage between tenants prevented?
Do you have an AI governance policy, and what does it require?
Which third-party model providers process data, and under what terms?
What is your published accuracy, and how was it measured?
